# WO-104: Honest feedback when copying the checksum fails (CP-02)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-designer
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)
Assigned to: Codex channel session, after WO-102
Source: docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md CP-02 (accepted as proposed)

## Goal
web/src/components/CopyHash.tsx clears success silently when the clipboard rejects. Show short, calm failure feedback telling the reader they can select and copy the visible code. Announce success only after the clipboard write succeeds; a retry restores success. The checksum text stays selectable, and the page still works without JavaScript.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Covers unavailable clipboard, rejection, success, repeated attempts, keyboard activation and a polite live-region announcement.
- No new dependencies; /download/ JavaScript stays under the 80 KiB budget (pnpm check); CSP unchanged (it is the one page allowed hashed scripts).
- If no existing harness can mock the clipboard, report that instead of adding tooling.
- `pnpm build`, `pnpm check` and `python scripts/content_check.py dist` pass.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/components/CopyHash.tsx
- tests/test_web_copy_hash.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Everything else, especially tighten-csp.mjs, astro.config.mjs and the download page itself.

## Check-in plan
Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done.
